require 'faye/websocket'
require 'json'
require 'bcrypt'
require 'securerandom'

module UserRoles
  ADMIN = 'admin'
  MODERATOR = 'moderator'
  USER = 'user'
  
  ASSIGNABLE_ROLES = [USER, MODERATOR].freeze
  PROTECTED_FIELDS = [:password_digest, :session_token].freeze
end

class User
  attr_accessor :id, :username, :email, :role, :password_digest,
                :session_token, :display_name, :avatar_url, :bio,
                :notification_prefs, :theme, :locale

  PROFILE_FIELDS = [:display_name, :avatar_url, :bio, :theme, :locale].freeze
  SETTINGS_FIELDS = [:notification_prefs, :email].freeze

  def initialize(attrs = {})
    attrs.each { |k, v| send("#{k}=", v) if respond_to?("#{k}=") }
  end

  def admin?
    role == UserRoles::ADMIN
  end

  def to_safe_hash
    { id: id, username: username, email: email, role: role,
      display_name: display_name, avatar_url: avatar_url, bio: bio }
  end
end

class UpdatePolicy
  def initialize(actor, target)
    @actor = actor
    @target = target
  end

  def permitted_fields(update_type)
    case update_type
    when :profile
      User::PROFILE_FIELDS
    when :settings
      base = User::SETTINGS_FIELDS
      base += [:role] if @actor.admin?
      base
    when :bulk_update
      compute_bulk_permissions
    else
      []
    end
  end

  private

  def compute_bulk_permissions
    fields = User::PROFILE_FIELDS + User::SETTINGS_FIELDS
    fields -= UserRoles::PROTECTED_FIELDS
    fields += admin_extra_fields
    fields.uniq
  end

  def admin_extra_fields
    @actor.admin? ? [:role, :username] : []
  end
end

class AsyncUpdateProcessor
  def initialize
    @pending_updates = {}
    @merge_strategy = :deep_merge
  end

  def enqueue(user_id, fields, values)
    @pending_updates[user_id] ||= {}
    fields.zip(values).each do |field, value|
      @pending_updates[user_id][field] = value
    end
  end

  def process(user)
    updates = @pending_updates.delete(user.id) || {}
    updates.each { |field, value| user.send("#{field}=", value) }
    user
  end
end

class WebSocketHandler
  def initialize
    @connections = {}
    @users_db = setup_test_users
    @processor = AsyncUpdateProcessor.new
  end

  def call(env)
    ws = Faye::WebSocket.new(env)

    ws.on :message do |event|
      handle_message(ws, JSON.parse(event.data, symbolize_names: true))
    end

    ws.on :close do |_event|
      @connections.delete(ws)
    end

    ws.rack_response
  end

  private

  def handle_message(ws, msg)
    case msg[:action]
    when 'authenticate'
      authenticate(ws, msg)
    when 'update_profile'
      update_user(ws, msg, :profile)
    when 'update_settings'
      update_user(ws, msg, :settings)
    when 'batch_update'
      batch_update(ws, msg)
    end
  end

  def authenticate(ws, msg)
    user = @users_db.values.find { |u| u.username == msg[:username] }
    if user && BCrypt::Password.new(user.password_digest) == msg[:password]
      user.session_token = SecureRandom.hex(32)
      @connections[ws] = user
      ws.send(JSON.generate({ status: 'authenticated', user: user.to_safe_hash }))
    else
      ws.send(JSON.generate({ status: 'error', message: 'Invalid credentials' }))
    end
  end

  def update_user(ws, msg, update_type)
    actor = @connections[ws]
    return unless actor

    target_id = msg[:target_id] || actor.id
    target = @users_db[target_id]
    return unless target

    policy = UpdatePolicy.new(actor, target)
    permitted = policy.permitted_fields(update_type)
    
    payload = msg[:data] || {}
    apply_filtered_update(target, payload, permitted)
    ws.send(JSON.generate({ status: 'updated', user: target.to_safe_hash }))
  end

  def batch_update(ws, msg)
    actor = @connections[ws]
    return unless actor

    operations = msg[:operations] || []
    operations.each do |op|
      target = @users_db[op[:target_id] || actor.id]
      next unless target

      op_type = (op[:type] || 'profile').to_sym
      policy = UpdatePolicy.new(actor, target)
      permitted = policy.permitted_fields(op_type)
      
      payload = op[:data] || {}
      schedule_async_update(target, payload, permitted, op)
    end

    @users_db.each_value { |u| @processor.process(u) }
    ws.send(JSON.generate({ status: 'batch_complete' }))
  end

  def apply_filtered_update(target, payload, permitted)
    payload.each do |key, value|
      field = key.to_sym
      target.send("#{field}=", value) if permitted.include?(field)
    end
  end

  def schedule_async_update(target, payload, permitted, op)
    filtered_fields = []
    filtered_values = []

    payload.each do |key, value|
      field = key.to_sym
      if permitted.include?(field)
        filtered_fields << field
        filtered_values << value
      end
    end

    if op[:merge_with_pending]
      merge_pending_fields(target, op[:merge_with_pending], filtered_fields, filtered_values)
    end

    @processor.enqueue(target.id, filtered_fields, filtered_values)
  end

  def merge_pending_fields(target, merge_data, fields, values)
    merge_data.each do |key, value|
      field = key.to_sym
      fields << field
      values << value
    end
  end

  def setup_test_users
    {
      1 => User.new(id: 1, username: 'admin', email: 'admin@example.com',
                    role: UserRoles::ADMIN,
                    password_digest: BCrypt::Password.create('admin_pass')),
      2 => User.new(id: 2, username: 'alice', email: 'alice@example.com',
                    role: UserRoles::USER,
                    password_digest: BCrypt::Password.create('alice_pass')),
      3 => User.new(id: 3, username: 'bob', email: 'bob@example.com',
                    role: UserRoles::USER,
                    password_digest: BCrypt::Password.create('bob_pass'))
    }
  end
end
